e.title: **爱尔兰央行执法（Enforcement）页**（`centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement`）：⭐ 站点标题逐字为「**Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**」——⭐ 它把**罚款去向**写清楚（逐字：**Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.**）；⭐ 它同时公开**未获授权公司警示**（逐字入口 **Unauthorised Firms Overview**、**Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**）与**三类通知**（**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices**，集中在 **Prohibition Notices page**）；⭐ 并链出**欧洲央行 SSM 处罚活动年报系列**（**ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity** 及 2020～2024 各年）。
e.summary: **爱尔兰中央银行（Central Bank of Ireland）的执法公开面**：本条补的是**「谁被处分」这一层**，也是本轮四条里**唯一把「罚款最终去哪」写明的一条**——逐字为罚款计入央行**结余收入**并**直接上缴国库（the Exchequer）**。页面另有三个值得单独记的结构：**① 未获授权公司警示**（**Unauthorised Firms Overview** 与 **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**），即**反假冒名单**；**② 三类通知**（**Disqualification Notices、Suspension Notices、Prohibition Notices**，集中在一个页面）；**③ 欧洲层面接口**——链接 **ECB 的 SSM 处罚活动年报**（**2025** 以及 **2020～2024** 各年）。本次实测 **HTTP 200 / 122,736 字节**，清洗后可见正文 **15,739 字符**。
e.body:
**爱尔兰中央银行（Central Bank of Ireland）的 Enforcement 页**（`centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement`）是**执法与处分的公开面**。⭐ 本条与**第 385 轮**收录的 [[eiopa-registers]]（欧洲保险与职业养老金登记）**不在同一层**：**登记册回答「谁在册」，本页回答「谁被处罚」**；⭐ 而它在本轮四条里**独有一项**——**把罚款的去向写清楚**。
**罚款去向逐字**：「**Enforcement Outcomes Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.**」——⭐ 即**行政处罚所收罚款进入央行结余收入，并直接上缴国库**。⭐ 这一条在比较研究里很有用：**不是每个法域都说明罚款进了谁的口袋**；**「监管机关是否自留罚款」是评价监管独立性的一个可核对维度**（⚠️ 本条**不作评价**，只记录爱尔兰的表述）。
**未获授权公司警示（反假冒面）**：站内逐字入口为 **Unauthorised Firms Overview** 与 **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**——⭐ 即**除了「谁被罚」，还有「谁根本没牌照却在活动」**。⭐ 这与**第 385 轮**在 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] 记下的那句「**If in doubt, check its official contact details on its website and the MAS Financial Institutions Directory.**」（MAS 把名录定位成防假冒工具）**是同一类制度设计**：**监管机关用公开名单来对冲冒充与诈骗**。
**三类通知与它们的落点**：页面逐字写「**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices can be found on the Prohibition Notices page.**」——⭐ 即**取消资格通知、暂停通知、禁止通知**三类**集中在一个页面**；另有入口 **Administrative Sanctions Procedure**（**行政处罚程序**）与 **Explainer - What enforcement powers does the Central Bank have?**（**执法权力说明**，即**面向公众的解释性材料**）。⚠️ **三类通知的件数与时间范围本次未取**。
**欧洲层面接口**：页面逐字给出「**ECB publishes on its website a report on sanctioning activity across the SSM which is based on the collation of data on sanctioning activity from the national competent authorities of participating member states.**」，并说明可链接到「**the ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity**」以及 **2020、2021、2022、2023、2024** 各年报告；页面另有一句「**As a result, the ECB can take direct enforcement and sanctions proceedings against significant institutions.**」——⭐ 即**在单一监管机制（SSM）下，重大机构（significant institutions）的处罚可以直接由欧洲央行提起**。⭐ 对做**多层监管（欧盟—成员国）**研究的人，这一页同时给出了**本国程序**与**欧洲层面的年度数据源**。
**与其他本轮条目的形态差异**：[[apra-enforcement]] 公开**登记册 + 承诺 + 侵权通知**（以「结果类型」组织）；[[mas-enforcement]] 公开**分类计数 + 执法报告**（以「数量」组织）；本页公开**罚款去向 + 未授权警示 + 三类通知 + 欧洲年报接口**（以「钱的去向与假冒防范」组织）；[[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] 以**条目式索引 + 处分事例集**组织。**四条四种用法**。
**同页还并列着另一类「sanctions」，性质不同，不要混读**：页面链接里同时有 **International Financial Sanctions** 与 **Financial Sanctions and Terrorist Financing - additional obligations**——⭐ 这里指的是**国际制裁与反恐融资义务**，与**违反本国法规所生的行政处罚（Administrative Sanctions）**是**两套东西**；⚠️ **中文里都译作「制裁」，是误读高发点**，本条**把两者分开记录**。
**「Explainer」这一形态值得记**：页面提供 **Explainer - What enforcement powers does the Central Bank have?**，⭐ 即**监管机关用通俗材料解释自己的执法权力边界**——对**消费者教育与监管透明度**研究是可直接引用的做法（⚠️ **该解释页正文未取**）。
**对 RIAA 学生的用法**：① 做**爱尔兰／欧盟保险机构尽调**时，本页是处分侧的入口；② 研究**监管处罚的透明度**时，「罚款去向」与「未授权公司警示」是**两个可直接比较的维度**；③ 做**欧盟多层监管**的，**ECB 的 SSM 处罚活动年报系列（2020～2025）是现成的时间序列**，⚠️ **但各年报告需要自行下载核对口径**。
**窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement` 实测 **HTTP 200 / 122,736 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**」，清洗后可见正文 **15,739 字符**（sanction 14 次、enforcement 28 次、prohibition 2 次、settlement 2 次、revocation 1 次命中）。⚠️ **未核实项**：① **各类通知与处分案件的件数、时间范围**未取；② **Administrative Sanctions Procedure 的具体程序步骤**未取原文；③ **ECB 各年 SSM 处罚报告未下载**（只记录链接存在）；④ **未授权公司名单的条数与更新频率**未取；⑤ **爱尔兰在 SSM 中的机构分类（significant／less significant）**未取。
e.verified_note: **窗口状况（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement` 返回 **HTTP 200 / 122,736 字节**，站点标题逐字「**Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**」；清洗后可见正文 **15,739 字符**（sanction 14 次、prohibition 2 次、settlement 2 次、revocation 1 次、enforcement 28 次）；同日实测，服务器 `date:` 头与本机 **2026-10-01** 一致。⚠️ **未核实**：① **三类通知（Disqualification／Suspension／Prohibition Notices）与行政处分的件数、时间跨度未取**——本条目**只记录入口与页内逐字表述**；② **Administrative Sanctions Procedure 的具体步骤**未取原文；③ **ECB 的 SSM 处罚活动年报（2020～2025）未下载**，仅记录页面给出该系列链接；④ **未授权公司警示名单的条数与更新频率**未取；⑤ **罚款金额的年度合计**未取。⚠️ 页内英文引文逐字照抄（含 Central Bank’s、ECB’s 等所有格，撇号按 **U+2019** 转写）。
e.title_en: **Central Bank of Ireland Enforcement page** at `centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement`: ⭐ the site title is, verbatim, **Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland** — ⭐ it says where the money goes, verbatim: **Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.**; ⭐ it also publishes **unauthorised firm warnings** (**Unauthorised Firms Overview**, **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**) and **three notice types** (**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices**, gathered on the **Prohibition Notices page**); ⭐ and it links out to the **ECB SSM sanctioning reports** (**ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity** plus **2020 to 2024**).
e.title_hk: **愛爾蘭央行執法（Enforcement）頁**（`centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement`）：⭐ 站點標題逐字為「**Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**」——⭐ 佢將**罰款去向**寫清楚（逐字：**Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.**）；⭐ 同時公開**未獲授權公司警示**（逐字入口 **Unauthorised Firms Overview**、**Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**）同**三類通知**（**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices**）；⭐ 並鏈出**歐洲央行 SSM 處罰活動年報系列**（**ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity** 及 2020～2024 各年）。
e.summary_en: **The enforcement disclosure surface of the Central Bank of Ireland**: this entry adds **who has been sanctioned**, and it is the only one of this round’s four that **states where the fines end up** — verbatim, monetary penalties under the administrative sanctions regime become part of the Central Bank’s surplus income and are **payable directly to the Exchequer**. Three further structures stand out: **unauthorised firm warnings** (**Unauthorised Firms Overview**, **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**), an anti-impersonation list; **three notice types** (**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices**, gathered on one page); and a **European interface** linking the **ECB SSM sanctioning reports** (**2025** and **2020 to 2024**). Measured this round: **HTTP 200 / 122,736 bytes**, **15,739 visible characters** after cleaning.
e.summary_hk: **愛爾蘭中央銀行（Central Bank of Ireland）嘅執法公開面**：本條補嘅係**「邊個被處分」呢一層**，亦係本輪四條中**唯一將「罰款最終去邊」寫明嘅一條**——逐字為罰款計入央行**結餘收入**並**直接上繳國庫（the Exchequer）**。頁面另有三個值得單獨記嘅結構：**① 未獲授權公司警示**（**Unauthorised Firms Overview** 同 **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**）；**② 三類通知**（**Disqualification Notices、Suspension Notices、Prohibition Notices**）；**③ 歐洲層面接口**——鏈接 **ECB 嘅 SSM 處罰活動年報**（**2025** 及 **2020～2024** 各年）。本次實測 **HTTP 200 / 122,736 字節**，清洗後可見正文 **15,739 字符**。
e.body_en:
**The Central Bank of Ireland’s Enforcement page** at `centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement` is **the public surface for enforcement and sanction**. ⭐ It is not on the same layer as [[eiopa-registers]] from Round 385: **the register says who is authorised, this page says who has been sanctioned** — and it has **one feature none of the other three in this round share: it says where the fines go**.
**Where the money goes, verbatim**: **Enforcement Outcomes Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.** ⭐ Monetary penalties become part of the central bank’s surplus income and are **paid directly to the Exchequer**. ⭐ This matters for comparative work: **not every jurisdiction states where penalty money ends up**, and **whether a regulator keeps its own fines is a checkable dimension of independence** (⚠️ this entry **records the Irish wording and passes no judgement**).
**Unauthorised firm warnings**: the in-site entries are, verbatim, **Unauthorised Firms Overview** and **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms** — so **besides who has been fined, the page covers who is not authorised at all**. ⭐ This is the same design idea recorded in Round 385 for [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]], where MAS tells users to **check the directory and use the contact details it gives** as an anti-impersonation measure: **regulators use public lists to counter impersonation and fraud**.
**Three notice types and where they live**: the page states, verbatim, **Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices can be found on the Prohibition Notices page.** ⭐ There are also entries for **Administrative Sanctions Procedure** and for **Explainer - What enforcement powers does the Central Bank have?** — that is, **public-facing explanatory material alongside the procedure itself**. ⚠️ **Counts and time ranges for the three notice types were not retrieved.**
**The European interface**: the page states, verbatim, **ECB publishes on its website a report on sanctioning activity across the SSM which is based on the collation of data on sanctioning activity from the national competent authorities of participating member states.**, and points to **the ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity** as well as the **2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024** reports; it also notes that **the ECB can take direct enforcement and sanctions proceedings against significant institutions.** ⭐ So for **multi-level supervision (EU and member state)**, this single page provides both **the national procedure** and **an annual European data source**.
**How it differs from the rest of this round**: [[apra-enforcement]] discloses **registers, undertakings and notices** (organised by type of outcome); [[mas-enforcement]] discloses **class counts plus a report** (organised by number); this page discloses **where fines go, unauthorised warnings, three notice types and the European report series** (organised around money and impersonation); [[japan-fsa-administrative-actions]] uses **an index of entries plus a casebook**. **Four pages, four uses.**
**How an RIAA student can use it.** (1) For **Irish or EU insurance due diligence**, this is the sanctions-side entry point. (2) For **penalty transparency**, **where the money goes** and **unauthorised firm warnings** are **two directly comparable dimensions**. (3) For **EU multi-level supervision**, the **ECB SSM sanctioning reports (2020 to 2025)** are **a ready-made time series**, ⚠️ **though each year’s report must be downloaded and its basis checked**.
**Window status (2026-10-01)**: `https://www.centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement` returned **HTTP 200 / 122,736 bytes**, site title verbatim **Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**, with **15,739 visible characters** after cleaning (14 hits of sanction, 28 of enforcement, 2 of prohibition, 2 of settlement, 1 of revocation). ⚠️ **Not verified**: (1) **counts and time ranges for notices and sanctions**; (2) the **steps of the administrative sanctions procedure**; (3) the **ECB annual reports** (links only); (4) **the length and update frequency of the unauthorised firms list**; (5) **Ireland’s significant versus less significant institution split in the SSM**.
e.body_hk:
**愛爾蘭中央銀行嘅 Enforcement 頁**（`centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement`）係**執法同處分嘅公開面**。⭐ 本條同**第 385 輪**收錄嘅 [[eiopa-registers]]（歐洲保險與職業養老金登記）**唔喺同一層**：**登記冊答「邊個在冊」，本頁答「邊個被處罰」**；⭐ 而佢喺本輪四條中**獨有一項**——**將罰款去向寫清楚**。
**罰款去向逐字**：「**Enforcement Outcomes Funds collected from monetary penalties imposed under the Central Bank’s Administrative Sanctions regime are included in the Central Bank’s surplus income which is payable directly to the Exchequer.**」——⭐ 即**行政處罰所收罰款進入央行結餘收入，並直接上繳國庫**。⭐ 呢條喺比較研究裡好有用：**唔係每個法域都講明罰款入咗邊個袋**（⚠️ 本條**不作評價**，只記錄愛爾蘭嘅表述）。
**未獲授權公司警示（反假冒面）**：站內逐字入口為 **Unauthorised Firms Overview** 同 **Warnings - Unauthorised Firms**——⭐ 即**除咗「邊個被罰」，仲有「邊個根本冇牌卻在活動」**。⭐ 呢點同**第 385 輪**喺 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] 記下嘅防假冒表述**係同一類制度設計**。
**三類通知同落點**：頁面逐字寫「**Disqualification Notices, Suspension Notices and Prohibition Notices can be found on the Prohibition Notices page.**」；另有入口 **Administrative Sanctions Procedure** 同 **Explainer - What enforcement powers does the Central Bank have?**（面向公眾嘅解釋材料）。⚠️ **三類通知嘅件數同時間範圍本次未取**。
**歐洲層面接口**：頁面逐字給出「**ECB publishes on its website a report on sanctioning activity across the SSM which is based on the collation of data on sanctioning activity from the national competent authorities of participating member states.**」，並指向 **ECB’s 2025 report on SSM sanctioning activity** 及 **2020～2024** 各年；另有「**the ECB can take direct enforcement and sanctions proceedings against significant institutions.**」⭐ 對做**多層監管（歐盟—成員國）**研究嘅人，呢一頁同時俾出**本國程序**同**歐洲層面年度數據源**。
**對 RIAA 學生嘅用法**：① 做**愛爾蘭／歐盟保險機構盡調**時，本頁係處分側入口；② 研究**監管處罰透明度**時，「罰款去向」同「未授權公司警示」係**兩個可直接比較嘅維度**；③ 做**歐盟多層監管**嘅，**ECB 嘅 SSM 處罰年報系列（2020～2025）係現成時間序列**。
**窗口狀況（2026-10-01）**：`https://www.centralbank.ie/regulation/enforcement` 實測 **HTTP 200 / 122,736 字節**，站點標題逐字「**Enforcement | Central Bank of Ireland**」，清洗後可見正文 **15,739 字符**。⚠️ **未核實項**：① **各類通知與處分案件件數、時間範圍未取**；② **行政處罰程序具體步驟未取原文**；③ **ECB 各年年報未下載**；④ **未授權公司名單條數同更新頻率未取**；⑤ **愛爾蘭喺 SSM 中嘅機構分類未取**。
